nom: StriVectin Super-C Eye Vitamin C Cream

segments.sensitive: Several reviewers who describe themselves as having sensitive skin report no irritation, breakouts, or discomfort and specifically value the fragrance-free formula, though one notes mild stinging and temporary redness on first application.
segments.dry: One reviewer with very dry, sensitive skin, previously advised against vitamin C products, reports no adverse reaction and plans to keep using it.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin credits a year of consistent use with slowing visible signs of aging around the eyes, noting puffiness and lines returned after a month without it.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using this as an anti-aging eye treatment report visibly smoother fine lines, less puffiness, and brighter, less noticeable dark circles within days to a few weeks of consistent use, with one long-term user crediting it with slowing visible aging. A few report no visible change, particularly within the first one to two weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the eye area feeling deeply moisturized and softer after use, including one with dry, sensitive skin who tolerated it well despite having been advised against vitamin C products. A minority report the opposite: the cream peeled, flaked, and left the skin around the eyes drier and cracked, especially when layered with other face products.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with very sensitive skin reports the cream can sting and cause redness on first application, fading into a glow within about half an hour with no lasting irritation.

aspects.libelle: Rich, creamy texture absorbs without greasiness
Pricey but a little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Not friendly when used with other product.
extraits.texte: Dissapointed in this product. The reviews hyped it up so much and I really wanted to love it, however, this product does not work well with other product such as creams, oils and makeup. -It peels like dry liquid glue when mixed with face cream and oils -My eyes have flakes when I wake up if used the night before. -It cracks when wearing makeup. -Has shown a pattern of drying my lids on the ends and it takes weeks to hydrate back.

I have mixed feelings about this product. The texture feels nice going on, and a very small amount goes a long way. However, it pills under concealer no matter how long I let it absorb. Because of that, I only use it on days when I'm not wearing concealer or makeup. It's fine for no or minimal makeup days, but not ideal if you plan to layer products. I also don't use it at night because I wake up with crusty eyes. I won't be repurchasing.

I have been using this product for a year. It's part of my morning regimen before applying makeup. It reduced puffiness and diminished fine lines. I have mature skin and this product helped slow down the aging. Recently I ran out and was without it for a month. As time went on, my eyes began to look puffier.More lines and wrinkles and looked just horrible. This week I purchased it again and after 2 days of use.I can start to see my eyes getting back to normal again. The venus has reduced and my eyes look smoother. I would recommend this product especially if you have much more skin.

I love good skincare and was excited to receive this product. My skin is very dry and sensitive, and I have been advised against using vitamin c products. I am happy to report that I have had no adverse reactions and will continue using it!

extraits.titre: Safe for sensitive skin but can sting at first
extraits.texte: The StriVectin Super-C Eye Vitamin C Eye Cream is a rich, thick cream that leaves your under eyes looking dewy and recharged. It has a faint, clean scent. I have been using it for nearly a week and can see a difference. My under eyes look brighter and more dewy which helps to diminish the appearance of my dark circles. I apply a small amount of the cream on clean skin in the a.m. and p.m., as directed. The cream can sometimes sting when I first apply it to my under eye area, and there is some redness. The redness fades into a glow within a half hour of application. My skin is very sensitive so I am happy I can tolerate this cream! I will be adding this to my skin care routine.

I really like this cream! I use it at night before bed because it has a rich, slightly oily texture that feels too heavy for daytime use, but it's perfect as a night cream. By morning, it's fully absorbed and my skin feels deeply hydrated. I also love that it's fragrance-free—strong scents before bed are not my thing. After about three weeks, I noticed a real difference: fine lines around my eyes looked much smoother, and now when I smile, there aren't nearly as many. I wouldn't recommend it as a daytime moisturizer, but as a night cream, it's absolutely fantastic.

extraits.titre: This eye cream has noticeable effects
extraits.texte: I have been using this for years cream for about a week and I'm already seeing results under and around my eye area. I'm in my early forties and really starting to see signs of aging and I was very very happy to have that week rested look with zero puffiness. My under eyes look hydrated and fine lines appear blurred. It absorbs very well and can be used for day or night. I will definitely recommend it's a great product.
